description: Platform Improvements - High-impact UX, SEO, accessibility, and performance enhancements identified during codebase audit

userStories.title: Add SEO meta tags to archive pages
userStories.description: As a site owner, I want all archive pages (TopicHub, AuthorArchive, CategoryArchive, TagArchive, DateArchive) to have proper SEO meta tags so that search engines can index them correctly and drive organic traffic.
acceptanceCriteria: Each archive page uses the SEO component with dynamic title and description based on the archive content
Canonical URLs are set correctly on each archive page to prevent duplicate content issues
Structured data (BreadcrumbList) is added to archive pages
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build

userStories.title: Add canonical URL support to SEO component and Article page
userStories.description: As a site owner, I want canonical URLs on article pages to prevent search engines from seeing duplicate content when articles are accessible from multiple URL patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: SEO component accepts an optional canonical prop
When canonical is provided, a <link rel='canonical'> tag is rendered in the head
Article.tsx passes canonical URL (https://danpearson.net/news/{slug}) to SEO component
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build

userStories.title: Add accessibility labels to Vault search and filter inputs
userStories.description: As a user with a screen reader, I want form inputs in the Vault dashboard and other admin components to have proper labels so I can navigate the interface effectively.
acceptanceCriteria: SecureVaultDashboard search input has aria-label='Search vault items'
All filter Select components in admin have associated labels or aria-label attributes
News.tsx search input has aria-label='Search articles'
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build

userStories.title: Add debounce to search inputs on News and admin list pages
userStories.description: As a user, I want search filtering to be debounced so that typing rapidly doesn't cause unnecessary re-renders and filtering computations on every keystroke.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a useDebounce hook (or use existing pattern) with configurable delay
News.tsx search uses 300ms debounce before updating filter state
ArticleManager search uses 300ms debounce
Search still feels responsive to the user
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build

userStories.title: Extract localStorage filter persistence into useLocalStorage hook
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a reusable useLocalStorage hook to reduce boilerplate and prevent sync issues when persisting filter state to localStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/hooks/useLocalStorage.ts with generic useLocalStorage<T>(key, defaultValue) hook
Refactor News.tsx to use useLocalStorage for searchTerm, selectedCategory, and sortBy
Hook handles JSON serialization/deserialization safely with try/catch
Existing behavior is preserved (filters persist across page visits)
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build

userStories.title: Add loading disabled state to admin mutation action buttons
userStories.description: As an admin, I want action buttons (delete, publish, webhook send) to show loading state and be disabled during mutations so I don't accidentally trigger duplicate operations.
acceptanceCriteria: ArticleManager delete button shows spinner and is disabled during deleteArticleMutation.isPending
ArticleManager publish/featured toggles are disabled during their respective mutation.isPending states
Save button in article dialog shows loading state during save operation
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build

userStories.title: Add lazy loading attributes to markdown-rendered images
userStories.description: As a user, I want images rendered in article markdown content to lazy load so that pages with many images load faster and use less bandwidth.
acceptanceCriteria: MarkdownRenderer (or equivalent) adds loading='lazy' and decoding='async' to all tags in markdown
Images have width and height attributes where possible to prevent CLS
Above-the-fold hero images are excluded from lazy loading
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build

userStories.title: Verify and fix dark mode color contrast for WCAG AA compliance
userStories.description: As a user with low vision, I want all text to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text) in both light and dark modes.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit muted-foreground color variable against dark mode background for contrast ratio
Fix any color combinations that fall below 4.5:1 ratio for normal text
Document the color changes made in commit message
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build
userStories.notes: Current muted-foreground (215 20% 65%) on dark backgrounds may not meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio

userStories.title: Add rate limit detection to ContactForm
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a clear message if I submit the contact form too many times in quick succession, rather than a generic error.
acceptanceCriteria: ContactForm detects 429 rate limit errors from the edge function response
A specific user-friendly message is shown: 'Too many messages sent. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.'
Submit button is temporarily disabled after a rate limit error with a countdown
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build

userStories.title: Add RSS feed auto-discovery meta tag
userStories.description: As a content consumer, I want the site to expose an RSS feed auto-discovery link so that RSS readers can automatically find and subscribe to the feed.
acceptanceCriteria: Add <link rel='alternate' type='application/rss+xml' title='Dan Pearson - AI Business Automation' href='/rss.xml'> to index.html or SEO component
RSS feed URL is accessible and returns valid XML
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build
userStories.notes: RSSFeed.tsx already exists but auto-discovery meta tag may be missing

userStories.title: Add copy-to-clipboard feedback in Secure Vault
userStories.description: As an admin using the Vault, I want to see a toast notification when I copy a secret or command to clipboard so I have confirmation the action succeeded.
acceptanceCriteria: Copy actions in SecureVaultDashboard and CommandBuilder show toast notification on success
Toast message includes what was copied (e.g., 'Secret copied to clipboard')
Clipboard API failure shows an error toast
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build

userStories.title: Replace window.location.href with React Router navigate in remaining components
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all internal navigation to use React Router's navigate() instead of window.location.href so that navigation is handled client-side without full page reloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit all uses of window.location.href for internal paths
Replace with useNavigate hook and navigate() calls
External links (mailto:, https:// to third-party sites) are left unchanged
Navigation behavior is preserved
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build
userStories.notes: Partially addressed - Index.tsx and CaseStudies.tsx already fixed. Check remaining components.

userStories.title: Add structured data to Connect page for ContactPage schema
userStories.description: As a site owner, I want the Connect page to have ContactPage structured data so search engines understand it's a contact page and can show rich results.
acceptanceCriteria: Connect.tsx includes StructuredData component with ContactPage schema type
Schema includes business name, email, and description
Validates successfully with Google's Rich Results Test
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build

userStories.title: Add error boundary per tab in admin dashboard for independent failure isolation
userStories.description: As an admin, I want each admin dashboard section to fail independently so that an error in one section (e.g., accounting) doesn't crash other sections (e.g., articles).
acceptanceCriteria: Verify all lazy-loaded admin sections are wrapped in SectionErrorBoundary
Test that each section can fail without affecting the sidebar or other sections
Add SectionErrorBoundary to any sections missing it
Typecheck passes
Build succeeds with npm run build
userStories.notes: Most sections already have SectionErrorBoundary, but verify complete coverage

userStories.title: Add newsletter signup conversion tracking to GA4 as a goal
userStories.description: As a site owner, I want newsletter signups tracked as GA4 conversions so I can measure signup rates and optimize the funnel in Google Analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: Newsletter signup success fires a 'generate_lead' event (already implemented in Analytics.tsx)
Document in README or CLAUDE.md that 'generate_lead' and 'newsletter_success' events should be marked as conversions in GA4 admin
Contact form success also fires 'generate_lead' event
Verify events appear in GA4 Realtime report during testing
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Analytics enhancement partially implemented - tracking methods added, GA4 conversion marking is a manual step in Google Analytics admin
